From: Elena Torres <elena@akrasys.com>
To: sales@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request: Private/VPC for regulated workloads

Hi Redwood team,

We signed up via the self-serve flow and selected a Private/VPC evaluation. Our company (AkraSys Health) needs a demo focused on on-prem/VPC deployment options, KMS/HSM integrations, and evidence for auditors (data retention, audit logs).

Preferred windows next week (PDT):
- Tue 2027-05-04 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2027-05-05 08:30–09:30

Attendees I expect to join: me (Elena Torrres), our Head of Security (cc: legal@akrasys.com), and an infra engineer.

Attached is a brief intake with regulatory bullets (AkraSys-intake.pdf). Please let me know who from Redwood should join and what pre-read we can review.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Product Security Manager — AkraSys Health

Attachment: AkraSys-intake.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-28T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Private/VPC for regulated workloads

Elena — thanks for the details and the intake doc. I’m marcus from the Redwood SDR team. Monica (CC’d) is our Solutions Engineer who will lead the technical deep-dive.

Quick items:
- Are you looking for a hosted-private managed option (Redwood Private) or a fully air-gapped on-prem pack? We can cover both in the demo.
- Would you like us to include a short security pre-call for your Head of Security and our security lead? That helps us bring the right artifacts (SOC2 blurbs, KMS integration guide).

I have availability the windows you suggested. Proposed slots (all PDT):
1) Tue 2027-05-04 10:00–11:00
2) Wed 2027-05-05 08:30–09:30

If either works I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short checklist we’ll share beforehand.

Best,
Marcus Lin
SDR, Redwood Inference

Marcus — thanks. Tue 10:00–11:00 PDT works best for us. Please include a security pre-call or at least have your security lead on the demo.

A couple of specific asks so Monica can prep: 
- We need to see KMS / customer key lifecycle (bring-your-own-key) and HSM options.
- Evidence types: audit logs, syslog export, and data retention controls (we will send a short questionnaire to legal).

I’m copying legal@akrasys.com for the questionnaire. Can you also share a short doc with the items you’ll present?

Thanks,
Elena

Hi Elena — Monica here (Solutions Eng). Thanks for the intake. I looked through the PDF and we’ll prepare a focused 45–50 minute demo covering:
- Deployment options: Private (managed VPC) vs on-prem installer
- Key management: BYOK flow, KMS + HSM options, rotation cadence
- Audit logs and export (syslog / S3 archival examples)
- Network isolation and tenant-level encryption controls

Dev (CC’d) is our security architect — he’ll join the security Q&A.

I’ve tentatively blocked Tue 2027-05-04 10:00–11:00 PDT. I’ll send a calendar invite in a separate email with an attached pre-read (AkraSys-Compliance-Checklist.pdf) and a short list of artifacts you requested.

Attachments: AkraSys-Compliance-Checklist.pdf (PDF, 75KB)

Regards,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
